language: Greek (many works survive only in Latin translations by Rufinus and Jerome)
role_place: Head of the catechetical school of Alexandria, then teacher at Caesarea (Palestine); the most prolific Greek theologian before Nicaea.
why_relevant: Gives the most detailed pre-Nicene account of the Mosaic law versus the Gospel (Against Celsus 7.26, De Principiis IV.17) and of why Christians do not carry out Mosaic penalties; answers Celsus' charge that Christians refuse arms and civic duty.
